select fpd.TRADE_ID as tradeId, fpd.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, fpd.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, fpd.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, fpd.BRANCH as branch, fpd.TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, ( CASE WHEN (fpd.VDATE is null) and instr('T01,T02', fpd.ps) >0 THEN fin.VDATE ELSE fpd.VDATE END ) as vdate, ( CASE WHEN (fpd.MDATE is null) and instr('T01,T02', fpd.ps) >0 THEN fin.MDATE ELSE fpd.VDATE END ) as mdate, fpd.SETTLE_DATE as settleDate, fpd.CCY as ccy, fpd.CPRICE_DATE AS cpriceDate, IFNULL(fpd.UNIT_CPRICE,0) as unitCprice, IFNULL(fpd.UNIT_INT,0) as unitInt, IFNULL(fpd.UNIT_FPRICE,0) as unitFprice, IFNULL(fpd.PAR_VALUE,0) as parValue, IFNULL(fpd.CPRICE_AMT,0) as cpriceAmt, IFNULL(fpd.SHARE_AMT,0) as shareAmt, IFNULL(fpd.PRIN_AMT,0) as prinAmt, IFNULL(fpd.INT_AMT,0) as intAmt, IFNULL(fpd.FPRICE_AMT,0) as fpriceAmt, IFNULL(fpd.FEE_AMT_PAY,0) as feeAmtPay, IFNULL(fpd.TRADE_AMT,0) as tradeAmt, IFNULL(fpd.FEE_AMT_UNPAY,0) as feeAmtUnpay, IFNULL(fpd.FEE_AMT,0) as feeAmt, fpd.PS as ps, IFNULL((fpd.YIELD)*100,0) as yield, IFNULL((fpd.EXER_YIELD)*100,0) as exerYield, fpd.INV_AIM AS invAim, fpd.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus, fpd.P_TRADE_ID as pTradeId, fpd.IS_CLEAN as isClean, fpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as totleTradeId, fpd.R_TRADE_ID as rTradeId, fpd.CHL_ID as chlId, mci.customer_name as counterId,
fpd.is_out_trade as isOutTrade, fpd.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, IFNULL(CASE fpd.TRADER WHEN 'null' THEN null ELSE fpd.TRADER END,'') as trader,
sma.SEC_ACCT_NAME as secManageAcctId, fpd.F_TRADE_ID as fTradeId, /**fpde.PROD_ID as prodId,**/ null as prodId,/**【一体化注释：金融产品交易附属表TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD去除对PROD_ID字段】**/ ba.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, ba.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate, ba.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, bad.BUSI_TABLE as busiTable, bad.BOK_DETAIL_ID as bokDetailId from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL fpd left join FIN_PRODUCT fin on fpd.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD fpde on fpd.TRADE_ID = fpde.TRADE_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on fpd.COUNTER_ID = mci.customer_id left join bok_DEAL_ACCOUNTING ba on ba.BUSI_TABLE = #{busiTable} and ba.BUSI_NO = fpd.TRADE_ID left join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL bad on bad.BUSI_TABLE = #{busiTable} and bad.BUSI_NO = fpd.TRADE_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO sma on sma.SEC_ACCT_ID = fpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID where 1=1
AND fpd.BUSI_TYPE IN
#{busiType}
AND fpd.PS IN
#{ps}
